_doc: S4 engine tripwires (tasks/stage-S4-living-ocean.md Acceptance, docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 12). 'tripwires' fail the run (exit 2), 'validity' marks a run whose load is not the one the tripwire assumes, that is too short, or that ran on a busy machine (1-minute load average per CPU thread), or did not draw (exit 3). --no-gate reports both and exits 0.
